name: architect
description: Agent Skills for the architect's whole working week, from concept to completion: briefs, site and planning research, drawings and diagrams, Rhino / Revit / IFC connectors, specifications, cost and carbon, coordination, construction-stage paperwork, winning work, and the hard conversations. Built on one rule: show the basis of every number, never fabricate a precedent, code, or citation, and flag what a qualified professional must verify.
